description: Source code for a web scraper class 'OttolenghiBooks' that extracts recipe information from a specific website, including title, author, yields, ingredients, instructions, description, dietary restrictions, keywords, and category.

classes.name: OttolenghiBooks
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from Ottolenghi's book website.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for the website.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts and converts the recipe yield to a standardized format.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients based on HTML structure.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of normalized ingredient strings.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns the recipe instructions as a joined string.

methods.name: dietary_restrictions
methods.description: Extracts dietary restriction tags from the recipe page.

methods.name: keywords
methods.description: Returns a list of recipe keywords, including special handling for certain books.
